visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit indoor home setting, two young girls with their hair in pigtails stand over an adult lying on the floor. The older girl wears an orange and white striped shirt, while the younger girl wears a green shirt with a french fry graphic. They hold toy hair salon tools near the adult's dark hair. (2) From a low-angle perspective, the younger girl uses a yellow toy comb to rub the adult's scalp. The background shows a wooden floor with scattered toy blocks and a colorful play mat featuring animal graphics. (3) The younger girl stands holding a small yellow toy hairdryer while looking directly at the person lying down. The older girl is partially visible in the background near a white sofa. (4) The older girl holds a large white toy hairdryer close to the adult's hair, her facial expression showing concentration and joy. (5) The older girl mimics cutting the adult's hair with white toy scissors, smiling widely with her mouth open. The younger girl meticulously combs a section of the adult's long black hair. (6) The adult's hand reaches up to give a small yellow round toy to the younger girl as a form of payment. The girl looks down at the hand. (7) A solid pink screen appears with a cartoon illustration of a girl in the center and white text at the bottom.
